title: Single-object arbitrary-field compactness obligation
statement: RETIRED INVALID SPLIT: For a scheme X, coefficient sheaf Λ, coproduct structure on the localizing closure, and a bounded constructible finite-Tor object K in that closure, K is compact. This is the objectwise compactness part of the disputed arbitrary-field witness. This is not an available compactness lemma. Its unrestricted assertion was false; no replacement theorem is asserted. The original Brown statement remains unchanged and unresolved.

old_proof.text: Finite-field compactness proves the analogous assertion after replacing the base by an algebraic closure of a finite field. For arbitrary positive-characteristic fields the required Ext bounds are unavailable, and the Kummer cup-product obstruction recorded on the parent statement shows that this objectwise assertion is false without an additional finiteness hypothesis.
